trap.label: vírgulas
trap.wrong: Douglass an escaped slave and a writer gave a speech that, changed history.
trap.right: Douglass, an escaped slave and a writer, gave a speech that changed history.
trap.why: O aposto vai entre vírgulas; já a relativa restritiva não leva vírgula, ao contrário do que o português às vezes sugere.

mcq.q: Which pronoun in a restrictive clause for a thing?

fix.wrong: Douglass, a writer gave a speech.
fix.right: Douglass, a writer, gave a speech.

fix.wrong: A speech, that changed history, was given.
fix.right: A speech that changed history was given.

fix.wrong: The man who he spoke was brave.
fix.right: The man who spoke was brave.

rewrite.prompt: Una com aposto: “Lincoln was a president. He gave a speech.”
rewrite.answer: Lincoln, a president, gave a speech.

rewrite.prompt: Una com “that”: “It was a speech. It changed lives.”
rewrite.answer: It was a speech that changed lives.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “Douglass gives a speech.”
